actions.description: The subsidiary management plan establishes sound baseline definitions, meets technical integrity criteria, and is consistent with upstream plans -- approve it to authorize baseline formalization
The subsidiary management plan has critical deficiencies, ungrounded assumptions, or irreconcilable contradictions with upstream plans -- reject it outright
The subsidiary management plan requires minor clarifications, boundary sharpening, or terminology reconciliation with upstream plans before authorization

metadata.decision_context: Evaluate one standalone subsidiary management plan under ADR-013 and recommend approve, reject, or request revision; every result remains subject to human adjudication.

complexity_profile.rationale: ADR-013 requires full-authority human adjudication for every standalone subsidiary plan.
